The public charge rule used fear to discourage immigrants from seeking critical health care and nutrition services.

Especially in the midst of a pandemic, this policy was cruel, unfair, and dangerous. 

I applaud @DHSgov @SecMayorkas for taking steps to end this policy.

Having a safe place to sleep can mean all the difference for families experiencing homelessness.

I'm proud to deliver $500,000 to @TheWholeChildCA—funding that will be used to construct an interim housing facility & supportive services center in #SantaFeSprings. https://t.co/YoRx0nRsT2

Early detection is one of the most powerful tools we have to slow the progression of Alzheimer's disease & related dementias.

With the support of @UsAgainstAlz, I introduced the #CHANGEAct to ensure more Americans have timely access to diagnosis and care. https://t.co/s8T1gyOZIz

I have long been an advocate on this issue in Congress.

My bill, the #CHANGEAct, would streamline early detection & diagnosis of Alzheimer's—improving outcomes for patients while ensuring caregivers have the information & help they need.

Click here to read more about this important legislation ⬇️
https://t.co/gh7wnvoIww

Today in history: The Voting Rights Act became law on August 6, 1965.

Generations of Americans fought, bled, & sacrificed to exercise their right to vote.

Despite attempts to dismantle the #VotingRightsAct, I'll keep fighting to protect & expand access to the ballot box. https://t.co/i6eRo0G2tP

No one should have to manage anxiety or depressive disorders alone.

Yet people of color receive less treatment for mental illnesses than the national average.

We must do more to ensure that ALL Americans have access to the quality, affordable care they need.

Today in history: The March on Washington is held on August 28, 1963.

Civil rights advocates, labor leaders, and religious figures came together 59 years ago to fight for equal rights.

Let us honor their legacy by continuing to push for equal treatment for all. https://t.co/c3F901lr4a

After experiencing mild symptoms on Sunday, I received a positive test result for COVID-19. I am following guidance from the CDC & the Office of the Attending Physician.

I am fully vaccinated & boosted, and thankful for the protection the vaccine has provided.

11 years ago, our country finally ended the discriminatory "Don't Ask, Don't Tell" policy.

It was a historic day for equality in our military—but our work is not done.

I’ll keep fighting to ensure LGBTQ+ servicemembers receive the equal treatment they have earned and deserve.

Every community needs access to safe, clean water.

I fought for this @EPA funding in Congress & I'm proud to have recently secured funding for two critical projects in #CA38:

✅ $2.5 million for @PicoRiveraCity's PFAS Treatment Project
✅ $2.5 million for @WRDSoCal https://t.co/BjfkPNtskQ

For millions of Dreamers, the United States is the only home they've ever known.

And they have made this country a better place every single day they've lived here.

I applaud @POTUS for making sure they have access to health coverage.

Next stop: citizenship.

The WIC program is critical to keeping families & children fed & healthy.

I'm proud to join @RosaDeLauro @RepJenniffer, @RepKimSchrier @RepBrianFitz @SenBobCasey & @SenatorCollins in introducing a bill that will help close gaps in WIC nutrition coverage.
https://t.co/QtPFUCmakQ

It’s time to think about health coverage for 2024!

Thanks to the Inflation Reduction Act, 4 out of 5 Americans can find plans for less than $10 a month!

Enrollment starts today and runs through January 31, 2024. Learn more here: https://t.co/uhLZQZyICc

Open enrollment season is here – now is the time to act!

Whether you are looking for new coverage or to update your existing plan, make sure to enroll by January 31st.

Explore your options at: https://t.co/uhLZQZyICc

TODAY is the last day to make changes to your 2024 Medicare coverage during Medicare open enrollment.

Visit https://t.co/9gM5XKgEtJ to compare coverage options and find the right one for your needs. https://t.co/oa2zMP1Hvh

Thanks to the hard work of @HouseDemocrats & @Potus, a record-breaking 20 million Americans have signed up for health care coverage through the ACA!

If you’re in California, there’s still time to compare plans & enroll.

Visit https://t.co/llZGfLOHZ2 today!

🚨 Calling all Californians! 🚨

Thanks to Democrats' effort to lower health care cost for American families, the #ACA marketplaces are more affordable than ever.

You have until THIS January 31st for 2024 health coverage.

Don't miss it & learn more here! https://t.co/uhLZQZyICc

This year, a record-breaking over 21M Americans have signed up for quality, affordable health care coverage through the #AffordableCareAct’s Marketplaces.

Today, more Americans have health insurance than under any other President in history! 👏👏 https://t.co/J62h6rZdUJ

Almost half of young people living with HIV don’t know they have HIV.

As a vice chair of the @EqualityCaucus, I’m committed to fighting for better health education and to ensure young people have access to HIV testing and treatment.
#NYHAAD https://t.co/LAFcdo53ch

I applaud @POTUS for new strengthened labor protections for temporary farmworkers that will protect against unsafe working conditions, labor law abuse & much more. Southern California has a vast agricultural industry & our temporary farmworkers deserve fair treatment & justice.

The "model minority" myth, language barriers, stigmas around HIV & being LGBTQI+, & fear of cultural shame often prevent AAPIs from seeking HIV treatment.

On #NAPIHAD, I’m working with @EqualityCaucus and @CAPAC to address HIV & AIDS in AAPI communities. https://t.co/YKq7N9mCiR

In Congress, I’m working with the @EqualityCaucus & @HispanicCaucus every day to support Latino communities in California in the fight against HIV & AIDS.

Get treatment, stick to it, get better! #NLAAD https://t.co/cDx4GDnaba

Republicans are saying the quiet part out loud.

They plan to cut $2.5T from programs like Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid that working-class families rely on so billionaires like President Musk get another massive tax cut they don't need.

President Trump giving Elon Musk control over the Treasury’s payment system is outrageous!

The richest man in the world shouldn’t have his hands on your Social Security or Medicare benefits. 

Congress must act immediately! https://t.co/W3unMnTssu
